tei:titleStmt.tei:title: (da)༄༅/ /mkha' spyod sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badzra yo gi nī/thugs rjes 'gro la rjes chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis bsgoms shing
(da)༄༅/ /mkha' spyod sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so/ /na mo badzra yo gi nī/thugs rjes 'gro la rjes chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis bsgoms shing

tei:div.tei:p: (da)༄༅/ /mkha' spyod sgo 'byed ces bya ba bzhugs so// na mo badzra yo gi nī/ thugs rjes 'gro la rjes chags mdzes pa'i sku/ /gang gis bsgoms shing gsang sngags tshogs bzlas pa'i/ /sgrub po mkha' spyod gnas su 'khrid mdzad ma/ /yi dam lha mo de la bdag skyabs mchi/ /bskyed rim rnal 'byor bcu gcig bsgom tshul dang / /tshes bcu sbyin sreg mar me'i sbyin sreg rnams/ /dad ldan slob mas gsol ba btab pa'i ngor/ /dam pa'i gsung bzhin gsal bar bri bar bya/ /rje btsun nā ro ta pas gzhan la ma gnang ba'i man ngag pham mthing sku mched nas brgyud pa'i rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i bsgom bzlas 'di la dpal sa skya pa chen po'i zhal nas rnal 'byor bcu gcig gis bsdus par gsungs te/ nyal dang ldang dang bdud rtsi myang / /tshad med bla ma bdag lhar bskyed/ /'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor dang / /dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab/ /ngag bzlas yid bzlas gnyis gcig yin/ /bsam gyis mi khyab rnal 'byor dang / /spyod lam gyi ni rnal 'byor te/ /de ltar rnal 'byor bcu gcig go /zhes so/ /de la dang po nyal ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ srod thun la bsgom bzlas byas nas thun mjug tu bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor bsgoms pa'i ngang la nyal/ ma bsgoms na skad cig gis stong pa nyid du bsgoms pa'i ngang la nyal/ bskyed rim la mos pa che na rin po che'i khri'i steng du rje btsun ma sha rus sogs rdos bcas ma yin par 'od kyi rang bzhin can du bsgoms pa'i spyi bor bla ma bzhugs par bsgoms nas de la phyag 'tshal bar bsgoms te nyal bar man ngag kha cig las 'byung bas de'ang legs pa yin no/ /gnyis pa ldang ba'i rnal 'byor ni/ nam mkhar ḍā ma ru'i sgra nye ba'i snying por grag pa tsam gyis bskul nas rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang bar bya'o/ /las dang po pas gnyid kyi ngang du de dran pa mi yong na'ang gnyid sad ma thag tu des bskul nas ldang ba yin no snyam du mos pa byas nas gnyid sad khar de dran pa 'byung ngo /

/gsum pa bdud rtsi myong ba ni/ bdud rtsi ril bu yod na snying ga'i bam̐ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas 'bru gsum brjod cing myong ngo / /med na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs la hub gsum 'thung ngo / /bzhi pa tshad med bsgom pa ni/ thog mar skyabs su 'gro ba byas nas bdag gis rdzogs pa'i byang chub kyi go 'phang thob par byas la sems can thams cad srid pa'i sdug bsngal gyi rgya mtsho las bsgral bar bya/ de'i ched du bdag gis lam zab mo bsgom par bya'o/ /zhes lan gsum brjod cing bsams te de la tshad med bzhi tshang gsung ngo / /lnga pa bla ma'i rnal 'byor ni/ mdun gyi nam mkhar seng ges bteg pa'i rin po che'i khri sna tshogs padma dang zla ba'i gdan gyi steng du rtsa ba'i bla ma rje btsun rdo rje chos kyi rnam pa can sku mdog dmar po zhal gcig phyag gnyis kyi g.yas pas bde stong gi sgra sgrogs pa'i ḍā ma ru 'khrol ba/ g.yon pas thod pa bdud rtsis gang ba thugs kar 'dzin cing / g.yon pa'i gru mo na kha ṭwāṃ ga bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung gis bzhugs pa/ sku la rus pa'i rgyan drug gis brgyan cing / gzhon nu lang tsho dar la bab pa'i sku can zhes brjod cing bsams la/ dus gsum gyi sangs rgyas thams cad kyi ngo bo bla ma dang rdo rje rnal 'byor ma gnyis su med pa la bdag phyag 'tshal zhing skyabs su mchi'o/ /byin gyis brlab tu gsol zhes lan bdun gsol ba btab ste/ bla ma 'od du zhu nas rang gi smin mtshams nas thim par bsam mo/ /drug pa bdag lhar bskyed pa ni/ rang gi snying gar e las chos kyi 'byung gnas gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du a las zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po'i mtha' mar g.yon skor du/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā zhes pa'i sngags kyis bskor ba las 'od zer byung bas lus phyi nang thams cad gang ste lus ngag yid gsum gyi sdig sgrib thams cad dag pas lus 'od kyi gong bur gyur/

de yongs su gyur pa las rang nyid rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la zhabs g.yas brkyangs pas dus mtshan ma dmar mo dang / g.yon bskums pas 'jigs byed nag po mnan pa/ sku mdog dmar mo zhal gcig phyag gnyis/ spyan gsum ma/ phyag g.yas pas rdo rjes mtshan pa'i gri gug thur du 'phyang zhing / g.yon pas thod pa khrag gis gang ba steng gi phyogs su bzung nas zhal gyen du phyogs pas gsol ba/ phrag pa g.yon par rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga la dril bu dang / ḍā ma ru dang / 'phan rtse gsum pa 'phyang bzhin pa bsnams pa/ dbu skra nag po sil bur gyur pa/ mi mgo skam po lngas dbur brgyan cing / skam po lnga bcu'i do shal can/ rus pa'i rgyan cha lngas brgyan pa/ ye shes kyi me 'bar ba'i dbus na bzhugs par bsams la/ de'i gnas rnams su zla ba'i dkyil 'khor re re'i steng du/ lte bar oṃ bam̐ dmar mo rdo rje phag mo/ snying gar ham̐ yoṃ sngon mo gshin rje ma/ khar hriṃ moṃ dkar mo rmongs byed ma/ spyi bor hriṃ hriṃ ser mo skyod byed ma/ spyi gtsug tu hūm̐ hūm̐ ljang gu skrag byed ma/ yan lag thams cad la phaṭa phaṭa dud ka tsaṇḍi ka ste/ dpa' mo'i go cha tsam dgod par bya'o/ /bdun pa 'gro ba dag pa'i rnal 'byor ni/ yang snying kha'i sngags phreng rnams las 'od zer byung ste/ ba spu'i bu ga nas song / rigs drug gi sems can rnams la phog pas de thams cad kyi lus ngag yid gsum gyi sgrib pa dag nas rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur gyur par bsam mo/ /brgyad pa dpa' bo dpa' mos byin gyis brlab pa ni/ lus kyis 'bar ba'i phyag rgya dpral ba'i dbyes su g.yon du bskor ba lan gsum bskor/ ngag tu phaiṃ zhes brjod/ sems kyis snying ga'i bam̐ yig las 'od 'phros te 'og min nas rdo rje rnal 'byor ma la phyogs bcu'i dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis bskor ba dang 'gro ba rnal 'byor mar bskyed pa thams cad kyang bdag gi ba spu'i bu ga nas thim par bsam zhing dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥzhes dang /

pad skor gyi mthar 'khyud pa'i phyag rgya byas nas/ oṃ yo ga shuddhaḥsarba dharmāḥyo ga shuddho3haṃ/ zhes brjod do/ /dgu pa bzlas pa la gnyis las/ dang po ngag gi bzlas pa ni/ snying gar chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi nang du zla ba'i dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su bam̐ yig dmar po la sngags kyi phreng ba g.yon skor du bkod pa las 'od zer 'phros/ sems can thams cad kyi sdig sgrib sbyangs/ sangs rgyas thams cad mchod/ de dag gi thugs ka nas thugs gnyis su med pa'i ye shes 'od zer dmar po'i rnam par spyan drangs/ snying ga'i sngags phreng rnams la thim pas rang gis rgyud byin gyis brlabs par bsams la/ oṃ oṃ oṃ sarba buddha ḍā ki nī ye/ badzra warṇa nī ye/ badzra bai ro tsa nī ye hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa phaṭa phaṭa swā hā/ zhes ci nus bzla'o/ /gnyis pa yid bzlas ni/ 'og rlung bskum/ steng rlung mnan te/ snying ga'i chos 'byung zla ba yig 'bru dang bcas pa bde ba skye bar 'dod na gsang gnas/ mi rtog pa skye bar 'dod na lte bar phab ste/ rlung kha sbyar nas grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil ba g.yon skor du 'khor ba dang / yig 'bru rnams la g.yon skor du dmigs te yid kyis bdun bzla'o/ /yid bzlas 'di rdzogs rim mtshan bcas yin pas drod dang bde ba skye zhing 'phar g.yo drag tu 'byung la/ de byung na yang rim gyis glod/ du ba la sogs pa'i rtags thams cad kyang 'di nyid las 'byung ngo / /bcu pa bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i rnal 'byor ni lte ba'i sngags phreng las 'od 'phros pas khams gsum thams cad 'od zer gyis gang / gzugs med khams thams cad 'od zer gyi rnam par byas nas lus kyi stod kyi cha la/ gzugs khams bar gyi cha la/ 'dod khams smad kyi cha la bsdu/ rang yang sku stod sku smad nas rim gyis bsdus te chos 'byung la/ de zla ba la/ de yig 'bru rnams la/ de bam̐ yig la/ de mgo bo la/

de zla tshes la/ de thig le la/ de nā da la/ de yang je phra je phrar mi dmigs te stong pa'i ngang la sems glod de ci tsam gnas tshad du gzhag go /zhi gnas shas che na lhar ldang / gsal ba dang bde shas che na stong par gzhag lhar ldang ba ni sngar ltar rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur ldang ngo / /bcu gcig pa spyod lam gyi rnal 'byor ni/ de nas spyod lam la 'jug pa'i tshe rang dang snang ba thams cad rdo rje rnal 'byor ma'i skur dmigs la bya byed kyi tshe lha la lhas mchod pa'i bsam pa sku'i dga' ba/ de'ang sgyu ma lta bu dang / bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las ma g.yos par dran par bya ba thugs kyi dga' ba/ sgra ci grag pa thams cad sngags su dran pa gsung gi dga' ba ste dga' ba gsum gyi ngang las bya ba thams cad bya'o/ /rnal 'byor bcu gcig bstan zin to/ /gnyis pa tshes bcu gnyis la sogs pa'i dus su tshogs mchod bya ba la/ mdor bsdus pa'i tshul dang / spros pa la dga' na rgyas par bya ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po la gnyis sngon 'gro dang / dngos gzhi'o/ /dang po la bzhi ste/ gnas/ dus/ rten bshams pa/ mchod rdzas so/ /dang po ni/ gnas khang phyag dar bya/ chag chag gdab/ bris sku la sogs pa'i rten rnams ji ltar 'tshams par bzhugs su gsol lo/ /gnyis pa ni/ tshogs gsog par 'dod na yar gyi tshes bcu/ sgrib pa 'dag par 'dod na mar gyi tshes bcu ni dus khyad par can yin la/ dus rgyun du'am/ nam spro ba'i dus su bya'o/ /gsum pa ni/ maṇḍal la tsandan dmar po brdar ba'i chus srin lag g.yon pas chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs g.yon skor du bri zhing / de'i nang thams cad tsandan dmar po'i chus byug tsandan dmar po'i chu med na chang bdud rtsir byin gyis brlabs pas de ltar bya/ dbus su me tog gi tshom bu bkod pa ras dmar po'i gzhi'i steng du gzhag kha bstan phyogs rnal 'byor pa rang nyid kyi 'dug sa dang khang pa dang bstun pas chog

mtha' gcig tu nges pa med do/ /bzhi pa ni/ rang gi g.yon maṇḍal gyi g.yas su me tog bdug spos/ mar me gsum mdun nas brtsams te phar rim bzhin bsham/ rang gi g.yas maṇḍal gyi g.yon du dri chab/ gtor ma dang lha bshos gsum yang mdun nas phar rim pa bzhin bsham/ mdun du chang phud dang tshogs kyi yo byad ci 'byor pa bsham/ rnal 'byor pa so so'i mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu rnams kyang bsham mo/ /gnyis pa ni/ du ma yod na las kyi slob mas maṇḍal phul te lha'i rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab/ de nas tshad med nas bzung ste bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las rje btsun ma phyag mtshan med pa'i skur langs pa'i bar sgrub thabs su bstan pa bzhin byas nas/ rang gi lte ba'i bam̐ yig las bam̐ yig gcig chad de maṇḍal gyi dbus su gnas pa yongs su gyur pa las rje btsun ma bskyed de/ zhal phyag gsal gdab pa dang / go cha bgo ba dang / ye shes pa gzhug pa rnams sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas nang mchod sumbhas bsang / swa bhā was stong par sbyangs/ stong pa'i ngang las yaṃ las rlung / raṃ las me'i steng du a las thod pa dkar po yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du go ku da ha na las sha lnga/ bi ra shu ma mu las bdud rtsi lnga/ 'og gi rlung g.yos/ me sbar bas rdzas rnams bskol nas 'od du zhu ste bdud rtsi'i rgya mtshor gyur par bsams la/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin sbyar bas chos 'byung g.yon skor du bri ste/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥzhes brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ nang mchod de nas mchod rdzas rnams la gtor te/ sumbhas bsang / swa bhā was sbyang / stong pa'i ngang las ye shes kyi ka pā la yangs shing rgya che ba rnams kyi nang du hūm̐ zhu ba las byung ba'i lha rdzas las grub pa'i me tog bdug spos/ mar me/ dri/ zhal zas/ gzhan yang rol mo la sogs pa'i mchod rdzas rnams dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsams la/ oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyis byin gyis brlab/

'bul ba'i tshe oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta shrī badzra yo gi nī sa pa ri wā ra zhes pa kun la sbyar la oṃ badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ nas oṃ badzra shabda āḥhūm̐ gi bar gyis mchod/ dharmā ra ṇi tas rol mo yang bya'o/ /oṃ gsum ma'i rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas nang mchod gtor/ de nas gtor ma nang mchod chu chang gis sbyang nas sumbhas bsang / swa bhā was sbyangs/ lag pa g.yas g.yon gnyis ka bstan pa dang / bya khyung gi phyag rgya bcas te/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ hoḥha ho hrīḥs byin gyis brlab/ phaiṃ gyi sgra dang 'bar ba'i phyag rgyas dur khrod brgyad po spyan drangs nas mdun bskyed kyi mtha' skor du 'khod par bsams la/ mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags dang / gsol gdab kyis dbul/ 'di la gtor ma gzhan med/ de nas mdun gyi tshogs rnams bdud rtsi ltar byin gyis brlabs nas phud snod gtsang ma'i nang du blugs la maṇḍal gyi mdun du bzhag ste/ gang gi drin gyis bde chen nyid/ /ces sogs tshigs bcad gcig gis bla ma la phyag 'tshal ba sngon du 'gro bas/ rje btsun ma'i sngags lan gsum gyis rje btsun ma la dbul/ yang gtor ma las cha gcig bzhag nas mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi sngags lan gsum gyis 'jig rten pa la dbul/ de nas snying ga'i bam̐ yig mchod pa'i bsam pas nang gi sbyin sreg gsal btab nas rnal 'byor pa rnams tshim par bza'/ lhag ma bsdus te 'bar ba'i phyag rgya phal pa dang / phaiṃ gyi sgras chang phal pa'i kha phru btab ste a kā ro lan gsum gyis phyi rol na gnas pa'i 'byung po la byin nas/ rdo rje'i glu dang bkra shis kyi tshigs bcad kyai rdor bzhin dang / 'chi tshe mgon dang dpa' bo ma tshogs kyis/ /zhes sogs dang / lha mo tshad ma dam tshig tshad ma dang / /zhes sogs kyis smon lam gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum gyis lhag chad kha bskangs nas/ mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdus nas/

maṇḍal dang mchod rdzas dman ma rnams bsdus te las kyi rjes mi mngon par bya'o/ /gnyis pa spros pa la dga' bas rgyas par bya ba'i tshul ni/ rten bsham pa'i skabs su sngar gyi maṇḍal ji lta ba bzhin bshams pa'i steng du mañdzi la sogs pa bzhag nas/ de'i steng du me long la sindhū ra dar tshags la btsags pa btab pa la chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs bris pa'i dbus su bam̐ yig dang / de'i mthar shar nas brtsams te yi ge sum cu rtsa gnyis g.yon skor du mgo phyir bstan pa bri/ de'i 'bri tshul yang shar nas brtsams te oṃ gsum/ g.yon skor du sarba dang / buddha dang / ṭā ki dang / nī ye dang / badzra dang / warṇa dang / nī ye dang / badzra dang / bai ro dang / tsa nī ye rnams rim pa bzhin g.yon nas bskor ba yin gyi/ nang sel gyi yi ge re re bzhin g.yon nas bskor ba ni ma yin no/ /de'ang shar drang por oṃ dang / byang drang por ḍā dang / nub drang por nī dang / lhor drang por nī byung na ma 'khrul pa yin no/ /de nas hūm̐ gsum dang / phaṭa gsum rim pa bzhin bri'o/ /'og tu bdud rtsi dang ting lo rnams ni dam tshig gso ba'i bdag 'jug dang / slob ma la byin rlabs kyi tshe dgos pa yin gyi/ 'dir mi dgos so/ /mchod rdzas kyi skabs su maṇḍal gyi shar lhor gnas srung ba'i me tog shar drang por mchod yon nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod g.yon skor du bsham/ de'i mdun gyi shar phyogs su 'das pa'i gtor ma dang / chos skyong gi gtor ma dang / 'jig rten pa'i gtor ma gsum yang g.yon skor du bsham/ chang phud tshogs rdzas snga ma bzhin bsham/ de nas maṇḍal zhu 'bul nas brtsams te cho ga gzhan thams cad snga ma dang 'dra ba la lha bskyed pa'i tshe sindhū ra'i dkyil 'khor la lha bskyed/ mchod pa byin rlabs dang 'bul ba'i tshe chu gnyis byin gyis brlab pa dang 'bul ba bsnan/ phyi mchod kyi rjes su nang mchod kyi dbus nas mtheb srin gyis rlangs nas thog mar rtsa ba'i bla ma'i mtshan la 'bru gsum btags pa dang /

de nas/ rdo rje 'chang / rdo rje rnal 'byor ma/ nā ro pa/ pham mthing pa sku mched/ klog skya shes rab brtsegs/ mal gyo lo tsā ba/ sa skya pa chen po/ slob dpon rin po che bsod nams rtse mo/ rje btsun rin po che grags pa rgyal mtshan/ chos rje sa skya paṇḍi ta/ 'gro ba'i mgon po chos rgyal 'phags pa/ zhang dkon mchog dpal/ na bza' brag phug pa/ bla ma dam pa bsod nams rgyal mtshan/ dpal ldan tshul khrims pa/ chos rje ye shes rgyal mtshan pa/ rje btsun kun dga' bzang po/ mus chen dkon mchog rgyal mtshan rnams kyi zhal du oṃ āḥhūm̐/ de nas rtsa sngags kyi rjes su 'bru gsum btags pas rje btsun ma la dbul/ de nas yi dam gzhan la 'bul ba sogs ma rgyud spyi dang mthun pa'i nang mchod rgyas par dbul lo/ /de nas/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ sogs shlau ka gnyis kyis bstod nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma byin rlabs snga ma bzhin byas nas dang po rje btsun ma'i sngags lan gsum dang / a kā ro lan gsum gyis rje btsun ma la dbul/ chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i nyer spyod kyis mchod/ nang mchod sngags kyi rjes su 'bru gsum gyis dbul/ bstod pa sngar bzhin no/ /gnyis pa rang gi chos skyong gang yin la dbul/ gsum pa mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis 'jig rten pa la dbul/ de nas gur nas 'byung ba'i rgyun bshags lan gsum dang / rigs lnga'i sdom gzung lan gsum dang / dam tshig nyi shu rtsa gnyis 'dzin pa lan gsum byas nas/ tshogs byin gyis brlab pa man chad snga ma bzhin du spyad par bya'o/ /tshes bcu la sogs pa'i tshogs kyi mchod pa bstan zin to// //sngags kyi nus pa dbyung ba'i phyir sbyin sreg bya bar 'dod pas/ rgyas par bya ba'i tshul dang / bsdus te bya ba'i tshul gnyis las/ dang po zhi ba'i thab khung spyi dang mthun par thig gdab pa'i nang du chos 'byung gru gsum nyis brtsegs kyi thig gdab/

chos 'byung gi ri mo rdul tshon dkar pos gcad/ nang thams cad rdul tshon dmar pos bkang ste mdun rgyab kyi grwa spangs pa'i grwa bzhir dga' ba 'khyil pa g.yon skor du bri/ dbus su nyi ma'i gdan la tshom bu dmar po dgod/ rang gi g.yon thab khung gi g.yas su chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma gnyis bsham/ rang gi g.yas thab kyi g.yon du yam shing dang / mar khu dang / til nag po dang / zho dang mar tsam pa la sbyar ba'i zas mchod dang / ka ra bu ram sbrang rtsi gsum gyi ril bu dang / dūrba dang / ku sha rnams bsham mo/ /rang nyid kha shar du bltas nas 'dug pa'i mdun du nang mchod/ rdo rje dril bu/ dgang gzar blugs dang bcas pa bzhag la/ bdag bskyed bsgom bzlas bsam gyis mi khyab pa'i ngang las rje btsun ma'i skur langs pa'i bar sgrub thabs bzhin bya'o/ /de nas thab dang / mchod rdzas/ bsreg rdzas rnams la nang mchod nas gtor zhing sumbhas bsang / swa bha was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las hūm̐ las rin po che las grub pa'i thab khung yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du bud shing brtsigs pa dang bcas pa dwangs shing thogs pa med par gyur/ hūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod pas byin gyis brlab/ mchod rdzas dang bsreg rdzas rnams kyang oṃ āḥhūm̐ las byung ba'i mchod rdzas dang / bsreg rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med par bsams la/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pa dang / so so'i sngags kyis byin gyis brlab bo/ /de nas oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes pas me sbar nas/ de'i dbus su padma dkar po dang zla ba'i steng du ram̐ las me lha ra skyes la zhon pa sku mdog dmar po/ zhal gcig phyag bzhi pa/ phyag g.yas kyi dang po mchog sbyin/ gnyis pas bgrang phreng / g.yon gyi dang pos dbyu gu rtse gsum pa/ gnyis pas ghundhe 'dzin pa/ ral pa'i thor tshugs dang ldan zhing / tshangs pa'i skud pa dang / kṛṣṇa sa ri'i pags pas stod g.yogs dang / dar dmar po'i sham thabs can du bskyed pa'i gnas gsum du yi ge gsum bkod nas/

rang gi snying ga'i sa bon las 'od 'phros/ shar lho nas me lha spyan drangs par bsam zhing / oṃ agna ye e hye hi zhes brjod nas/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥs gnyis su med par bstim/ yang 'od 'phros pas dbang gi lha rigs lnga spyan drangs/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis 'di la mngon par dbang bskur ba stsal du gsol/ zhes gsol ba btab pas/ oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī āḥhūm̐ḥzhes gsung zhing dbang bskur/ sku gang dri ma dag chu'i lhag ma yar lud pa las rnam par snang mdzad kyis dbur brgyan par bsam mo/ /de'i ljags las 'od zer byung bas byon zan gsol bar bsam zhing / oṃ agne ye swā hā/ zhes brjod cing blugs gzar bdun gyis dgang gzar dgang ba lan gsum gyis byon zan dbul/ oṃ agne ye zhes pa kun la sbyar ba'i arghaṃ nas shabda'i bar gyis mchod/ oṃ agne ye oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes pas nang mchod dbul/ 'jig rten dbang phyug tshangs dbang mgon gyi sras/ /me lha'i rgyal por ḍā kis dbang bskur ba/ /shes rab mchog gis nyon mongs thams cad sreg /'jigs byed me lha nyid la rnam par 'dud/ /ces pas bstod/ de nas oṃ agne ye sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags 'di 'ba' zhig gis bsreg rdzas rnams lnga lnga'am bdun bdun tsam dbul/ slar yang sngar ltar mchod bstod byas nas/ oṃ agne dzwa la raṃ zhes pas me lha 'bar ba'i rnam par gyur par bsam mo/ /des nas 'bar ba'i dbus su rdo rje rnal 'byor ma bdag bskyed ji lta ba bzhin ye shes pa gzhug pa'i bar bskyed nas/ oṃ badzra yo gi nī zhes pa sbyar ba'i byon zan dang phyi mchod nang mchod rnams snga ma bzhin bya/ dpal ldan rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma/ /sogs shlau ka gnyis kyis bstod/ de nas rdzas rnams oṃ gsum ma'i swā hā'i gong du sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye zhes pa la swā hā sbyar ba'i sngags 'di 'ba' zhig gis bsreg rdzas rnams brgya rtsa brgyad la sogs pa ci tsam nus pas dbul/

slar yang mchod bstod snga ma bzhin byas nas tshogs mchod kyi skabs su bstan pa ltar gtor ma'ang dbul/ rje btsun rdo rje rnal 'byor mas bdag dang sems can thams cad kyi sdig pa dang sgrib pa thams cad byang zhing dag par byin gyis brlab tu gsol/ zhes sogs 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ yi ge brgya pa lan gsum dang / ma 'byor pa dang nyams pa dang / /sogs kyis nongs pa bzod par gsol nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu bar bya'o/ /slar yang me'i nang du oṃ badzra dzwa la raṃ zhes pas/ me lha gsal btab nas sreg rdzas lhag ma rnams lan gsum phul nas sngar ltar mchod bstod bya ste/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor ltar byin gyis brlabs la oṃ agna ye na maḥsarba ta thā ga te bhyo zhes pa lan gsum gyis dbul/ oṃ agne ye badzra muḥzhes pas ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa bdag la bsdu'o/ /gnyis pa bsdus te bya ba'i tshul ni/ cho ga gzhan rnams snga ma dang 'dra ba las thab 'bri ba'i tshe re khā zlum po nyis skor gyi nang du chos 'byung nyis brtsegs snga ma bzhin bri/ gzhan rgyas pa mi dgos/ rang gi g.yas su bsreg rdzas mar khu dang til 'ba' zhig bsham/ g.yon du mchod pa lnga dang / gtor ma gcig bsham/ bdag bskyed dang / thab dang / rdzas rnams byin gyis brlab pa snga ma bzhin byas nas me sbar te/ 'jig rten pa'i me lha mi bskyed par rje btsun ma bskyed de/ phyi mchod nyer spyod lnga dang / nang mchod dang / bstod pa rnams bya'o/ /phyi mchod kyi gong du byon zan snga ma ltar phul na'ang rung zhing / ma phul na'ang nyes pa med/ de nas bsreg rdzas til 'ba' zhig sngar gyi sngags kyis ci nus dbul/ skabs skabs su mar gyis me gso/ mthar mchod bstod snga ma bzhin byas nas 'dod pa'i don la gsol ba gdab/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyis dbul/ me lha'i rje btsun ma'i zhabs kyi drung nas blangs par dmigs te/

lag pa g.yon pa'i srin lag gis sbyin sreg gi thal ba zhig blangs la rang gi mdzod spur bsku/ yang na dpral ba/ mgrin pa/ snying ga gsum du bsku'o/ /'di ni srung ba'i mchog ste/ sngar gyi rgyas pa'i skabs su'ang bya'o/ /de nas mdun bskyed kyi ye shes pa gshegs/ dam tshig pa rang la bsdu'o/ /bzhi pa rnal 'byor pa gang zhig mar me'i sbyin sreg byed par 'dod na/ mar me'i kong bu yangs pa la mar dkar gyi khu ba dang / ras dmar po'i sdong bu sbom po btsugs la me sbar/ 'byor na mchod pa lnga dang / gtor ma'ang bsham/ rang nyid thun mtshams kyi rje btsun ma dran pa tsam gyis gsal btab ste/ mar me bdag bskyed kyi skabs ltar rje btsun mar bskyed/ mdun du til bzhag la/ bdag gis tshe thog ma med pa nas bsags pa'i las kyi sgrib pa thams cad sna sgor sdig pa rwa can gyi rnam par gyur nas mdun gyi til la thim par bsams la/ ngag tu oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha/ khā hi khā hi/ sarba pā paṃ shāntiṃ ku ru ye swā hā/ zhes pas til bsreg mchod pa lnga dang gtor ma yod na oṃ badzra yo gi nī badzra puṣpe āḥhūm̐ zhes sogs kyis dbul/ gtor ma mkha' 'gro spyi gtor gyi cho gas dbul lo/ /'di ni sdig pa thams cad 'dag pa dang / rje btsun ma'i byin rlabs 'jug pa'i thabs yin par gsungs so/ /gdams pa rgya mtsho'i gting mtha' mi dpog kyang / /dkon mchog rgyal mtshan gsung gi man ngag las/ /cung zad rnyed 'di kun dga' bde legs kyis/ /bskul ba'i ngor ni bsod nams seng ges sbyar/ /'dir 'bad dge tshogs gang zhig thob pa des/ /bdag dang mkha' mnyam 'gro ba ma lus pa/ /rgyal ba'i yum mchog de yis rjes bzung nas/ /mkha' la spyod pa'i gnas su skye bar shog /dge'o// // ༈ bal yul mchod rten nye 'dabs nas rgyal yongs sa chen zhes pa las/ slob bu tha shal pa gu rus spel ba'o// PAGE \* MERGEFORMAT 2 go bo rab 'byams pa/
